drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and experimental sound design. A distorted kick drum hits on every quarter note with a long, saturated sub-bass tail. A metallic, high-pitched percussive hit functions as a snare on beats two and four. A syncopated, resonant synth sequence with a high-pass filter sweep repeats every two bars. Granular synthesis textures and white noise bursts occur at irregular intervals. The tempo is 135 BPM in the key of C minor. A low-frequency oscillator modulates the cutoff of a saw-wave bass synth, creating a rhythmic pumping effect. Short, dry hi-hats play sixteenth-note patterns with varying velocity.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, saturated sub-bass]
[metallic percussion hits on 2 and 4]

[Main Section]
[syncopated resonant synth sequence enters]
[high-pass filter sweep]
[sixteenth-note hi-hat pattern]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out]
[granular white noise bursts]
[filtered saw-wave bass modulation]

[Outro]
[kick drum returns]
[instruments fade out individually]
[final distorted bass tail]

bass.tags: Boom bap hip hop instrumental. A gritty, lo-fi drum break features a heavy, thumping kick and a crisp, layered snare with a slight swing. A prominent, repetitive bassline consists of a deep, sub-heavy synth tone playing a syncopated two-bar loop. A melodic hook is provided by a sampled, high-pitched soul vocal chop, heavily processed with a band-pass filter and short delay. Atmospheric texture is added by a vinyl crackle layer and occasional, muted electric piano chords with a tremolo effect. The track maintains a steady 92 BPM in the key of C minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, lo-fi drum break enters]
[syncopated synth bass enters]

[Main Section]
[filtered vocal chop loop enters]
[muted electric piano chords with tremolo]
[heavy kick and snare backbeat]

[Breakdown]
[vocal chop drops out]
[bass and drums continue with vinyl crackle]

[Outro]
[vocal chop re-enters]
[instruments fade out leaving only vinyl crackle]
